threads.body: [Testing] The new metrics-enabled profile omits supported consumer telemetry, including `kafka.consumer.fetch_latency_avg`, `kafka.consumer.records_lag`, and the `kafka.cluster.id` attribute. `AbstractOpenTelemetryMetricsReporterTest.observeMetrics()` exercises this telemetry but reads `testing().metrics()` directly, bypassing metadata collection. Capture the exercised consumer metrics and attributes with `waitAndAssertMetrics` after its produce/consume cycle, then regenerate the catalog rather than editing this generated file by hand.

threads.body: [General] This removes all native `kafka.consumer.*` and `kafka.producer.*` metrics from the standalone `kafka-clients-2.6` inventory, although `KafkaTelemetry.metricConfigProperties()` still enables them. The library reporter test runs only in the `Regression` execution, which the metadata collector does not select. Add a dedicated library metrics collection execution labeled for `KafkaTelemetry.metricConfigProperties()`, register it in `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh`, and regenerate the catalog so these metrics remain documented under their actual enabling condition.
